title: English I
standfirst: Written and spoken English for a technical audience: comprehension, composition, presentation.
instructor: Prof. Rajesh Kumar, Prof. Shreesh Chaudhary, Prof. Om Prakash & Ms. Karthika Sathyanathan

description_paragraphs: This course aims to develop fluency and confidence in both spoken and written English, drawing on insights from learning theories and established language-teaching methods.
faculty: Prof. Rajesh Kumar, Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, IIT Madras
Prof. Shreesh Chaudhary, Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, IIT Madras
Prof. Om Prakash, Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, Gautham Buddha University, Noida
Ms. Karthika Sathyanathan, Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Sounds and words; Vowel and consonant sounds articulation; Diphthongs, semi-vowels, consonant clusters.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Parts of speech - nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs; Prepositions, conjunctions, interjections; Articles.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Vocabulary; Phrasal verbs; Modal verbs; Phrases and idioms.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Spoken English basics; Speaking pace and pauses; Structuring speech; Presentations; Telephone English.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Tenses (past, present, and future); Subject-verb agreement and practice.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Reading skills - skimming, scanning, SQ3R, PQRST; Short and long texts; Critical reading; Test preparation.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Listening skills - active vs passive, barriers; Technical talks; Practice and test preparation.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Aspiration, word stress, syllables and syllabification; Plurality.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Speaking skills - presentations and slides; Group discussions (rules); Storytelling; Speaking test preparation.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Grammar and common errors; Writing basics - describing visuals; Public writing.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Writing - notes, business writing, instructions; Data interpretation; Essays; Clarity and simplicity.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Professional writing - paragraphs, formality and tone; Editing.
